description: This file implements JSON handling functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including error message formatting, static tag definitions for JSON elements, and debug string generation for JSON variants and containers.

classes.name: IElement
classes.description: Interface for JSON elements with static tags for null, true, and false.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Represents a JSON value with various types and provides debugging string output.

classes.name: VariantContainer
classes.description: Container for multiple Variants, providing a debug string output for all contained variants.

methods.name: ErrorDisplayMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message with context and position information.

methods.name: Variant::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a formatted debug string representing the Variant's current state.

methods.name: VariantContainer::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a concatenated debug string for all Variants in the container.
